item.title: Time for Jamaat and Shibir to Die
item.description: K S T Qureshi Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami (“Jamaat”) and its student wing, Islami Chhatra Shibir (“Shibir”), stand today as some of the most enduring political organisations in the country’s history.
